stem:
Meena dissolves 4 spoons of sugar in 200 mL of water in a glass. Her brother Arjun dissolves 2 spoons of sugar in 200 mL of water in an identical glass. Both stir until all the sugar dissolves.

Which row correctly compares Meena's glass with Arjun's glass?

options.text: more sugar dissolved in the same amount of water: no; more concentrated: no
more sugar dissolved in the same amount of water: no; more concentrated: yes
more sugar dissolved in the same amount of water: yes; more concentrated: no
more sugar dissolved in the same amount of water: yes; more concentrated: yes

tables: {"headers":["more sugar dissolved in the same amount of water","more concentrated"],"rows":[["no","no"],["no","yes"],["yes","no"],["yes","yes"]],"row_labels":["A","B","C","D"],"caption":"","is_option_table":true}

teacher.key_rationale: Both glasses contain the same amount of water (200 mL). Meena's glass has more dissolved solute (4 spoons vs 2 spoons) in that fixed amount of water, so it contains more sugar dissolved and is therefore the more concentrated solution. The correct row is yes/yes, which is option D. The trap options are A (ignoring the solute difference entirely) and B/C (treating the two properties as independent rather than linked).
